lines.zh: 六条腿稳稳推开草丛，我走着。
lines.en: Six legs push the grass apart as I walk.

lines.zh: 头顶的冠在太阳下泛红。
lines.en: The crest on my head goes red in the sun.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把土踩得很实。
lines.en: Step by step I firm the soil down.

lines.zh: 我沿着泥岸走，边走边啃。
lines.en: I walk the muddy bank, grazing as I go.

lines.zh: 身子太重，转弯要绕大圈。
lines.en: I'm too heavy to turn tight; I take wide arcs.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖在身后，扫着草。
lines.en: My tail trails behind, sweeping grass.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，找嫩的草尖。
lines.en: I lower my head to find the tender tips.

lines.zh: 六条腿的节奏很慢，很稳。
lines.en: Six legs keep a slow, even rhythm.

lines.zh: 走过的地方草都朝一边倒。
lines.en: The grass all lies one way where I pass.
I stop, then shift two steps on.
I smell standing water ahead.
The herd's behind me, loosely strung.

lines.zh: 我绕过那棵倒树，很轻松。
lines.en: I go around the fallen tree easily.
The plates on my back tick with each step.

lines.zh: 我走得比看上去快一些。
lines.en: I'm a little quicker than I look.

lines.zh: 我把冠甩了一下，像在示意。
lines.en: I toss my crest, as if pointing.

lines.zh: 我站着，六条腿分工撑着。
lines.en: I stand with my six legs braced apart.
I chew my cud slowly; my throat moves.
The colour in my crest has faded a little.
I lower my head level with the grass tips.

lines.zh: 我听着田那边有没有人。
lines.en: I listen for anyone beyond the field.
I chew my cud slowly in the shade.
I flick my tail tip at the flies.

lines.zh: 我的甲片上积了一层灰。
lines.en: A layer of dust sits on my plates.

lines.zh: 我换了一条腿撑住身子。
lines.en: I shift to another leg for support.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸长，够到高处的叶。
lines.en: I stretch my neck for a high leaf.

lines.zh: 这么站着，我一点也不累。
lines.en: Standing like this, I'm not tired at all.
I'm waiting for the sun to shift.

lines.zh: 旁边的水洼映出了我的冠。
lines.en: The puddle beside me shows my crest.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，草都动了动。
lines.en: I snort, and the grass stirs.
I shift my weight to the rear.

lines.zh: 雨味一到，我的冠就淡了。
lines.en: When rain comes, my crest fades.
You're standing very close to my crest.
My crest casts a shadow on your face.
All six of my legs have gone still.
I'm in no hurry; I'll look at you slowly.
Your smell isn't one I know.

lines.zh: 我的冠在太阳下很显眼。
lines.en: My crest stands out in the sun.
You stepped back; I can see.

lines.zh: 我不追人，除非有人追我。
lines.en: I don't chase people unless they chase me.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴垂着，不是要打。
lines.en: My tail hangs low; I'm not about to strike.
What's that in your raised hand?

lines.zh: 我伸长了脖子，闻你的手。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and sniff your hand.

lines.zh: 你的影子刚好在我脚下。
lines.en: Your shadow lands right at my feet.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，腿弯了下去。
lines.en: I cry out and my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的侧甲上。
lines.en: That landed on my side plate.
I take two steps back and hold.
Blood runs down between my plates.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，护住脖子。
lines.en: I lower my head to guard my neck.
My crest is askew.

lines.zh: 我的血从甲缝里往下滴。
lines.en: Blood drips from my plate seams.
A layer of dust fell off me.
It hurts; I'm still standing.
I shift my weight to the back legs.
Tender leaves — I'm coming over.
This smells good.
I stretch my head over, quite close.
Set it down and I won't crowd you.
So little — gone in one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我六条腿都往前挪了一步。
lines.en: All six legs stepped forward.
Sweet — much better than grass.
Don't raise it; my neck isn't that long.

lines.zh: 我闻着它，口水都下来了。
lines.en: One sniff and I'm drooling.
I eat slowly; don't rush me.
I'll want more after this.

lines.zh: 这是我这季吃到最好的。
lines.en: The best thing I've eaten this season.
I curl my tongue around it.
Don't pull your hand back; I'm not done.
I'm chewing — look at my crest.
Feed me this and I'll settle down.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的侧甲上，退了两步。
lines.en: You hit my side plate and go back two steps.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，六条腿撑住。
lines.en: I sway once and six legs brace.

lines.zh: 我这么大个，转身要绕圈。
lines.en: This bulk of mine needs a wide turn.

lines.zh: 你站到我冠的影子里了。
lines.en: You've stepped into my crest's shadow.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我身上的灰全落了。
lines.en: That knock dropped all the dust off me.
I shift my forebody to let you pass.
That was a solid bump.
You're much softer than stone.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，草都压平了。
lines.en: I give half a step and flatten the grass.
Next time I'll go slower.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，冠的颜色变深了。
lines.en: I lift my head and my crest darkens.

lines.zh: 她也把头抬起来，我们对看。
lines.en: She lifts her head too and we look at each other.

lines.zh: 我把头靠过去，碰了碰她的颈。
lines.en: I lean in and touch her neck.

lines.zh: 六条腿交叠，我们站着不动。
lines.en: Six legs overlap; we stand without moving.

lines.zh: 我把嚼软的叶子让给她。
lines.en: I give her the leaves I've softened.
We walk side by side for a while.
Her crest is smaller than mine.
I call low and slow.

lines.zh: 这一片草够我们吃很久。
lines.en: This grass will feed us a long while.

lines.zh: 太阳下去之前，我们不走散。
lines.en: We won't separate before the sun goes.
I take a bunch of grass and chew slowly.
I gnaw twice at this bark.
I press the thing flat with a front leg.
It fell out of my mouth.
I try it; it won't give.
I swallow the fruit whole.
This doesn't taste like grass.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把它推下田埂。
lines.en: I nudge it off the field ridge.
Fallen fruit; I chew it slowly.
I carry it a little way.

lines.zh: 草尖一动，我的冠就转了。
lines.en: Grass stirs; my crest turns.

lines.zh: 我把冠抬起来，看清了它。
lines.en: I raise my crest and see it clearly.
Six legs spread wide.
I turn broadside and block the way.

lines.zh: 我不叫，先让它听见我的呼吸。
lines.en: I don't call; I let it hear me breathe.
If it comes, I charge.
I've picked its flank.
Head down, my crest forward.
I puff myself out wide.

lines.zh: 我压低冠，前腿先探出去。
lines.en: Crest low, I reach out a foreleg.
I turn slowly, six legs shuffling.
It circles; I swing broadside.
I keep it in front of me.
I duck my head and point my crest.

lines.zh: 它往前一步，我就顶回去。
lines.en: It takes a step; I push back.

lines.zh: 我每呼气，草都往一边倒。
lines.en: Each breath bends the grass aside.

lines.zh: 它一停，我六条腿就定住。
lines.en: It stops; my six legs lock.
This is close enough for one charge.
I'm watching its legs.
I don't give a step.

lines.zh: 我低头一撞，它翻了过去。
lines.en: I lower my head and it flips over.
My crest sweeps and shoves it aside.
A front leg comes down hard.

lines.zh: 这一撞是我全身的重量。
lines.en: That charge was all my weight.

lines.zh: 我尾巴横扫，它站不住了。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and it loses footing.
I hook with my crest.
It backs off; I only lower my crest.
I settle and reset my stance.
It'll remember that.
It's down; I step back.

lines.zh: 我站起来的时候，土都塌了。
lines.en: When I rise, the soil gives way.

lines.zh: 六条腿撑住身体，我晃了一下。
lines.en: Six legs take my weight; I sway once.

lines.zh: 落地还晃，我就低头啃草。
lines.en: Still swaying, I lower my head to graze.
My crest catches the light.
The mud's wet here — suits me.
Several shadows stand behind me.
I lower my head and take my first bite.
My shadow runs longer than the grass.
The wind carries water-smell.
I lift a leg to test a step.

lines.zh: 甲片被烧得发烫，我打滚。
lines.en: My plates burn hot and I roll.

lines.zh: 我从高坡滚下来，很重地落地。
lines.en: I tumble down a slope and land hard.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water pours into my nose and I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 冲击掀翻了我整个身体。
lines.en: The blast turns my whole body over.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的甲缝里。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my plate seam.
Something inside me is twisting.
Not enough grass; I stand unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷落在冠上，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits my crest and numbs me through.

lines.zh: 没有地，我的六条腿乱蹬。
lines.en: No ground; my six legs thrash.
